name: init
description: Establish and converge on a shared repository overview before task-specific planning.

steps.action: First inspect active same-workspace peer sessions through the active harness transport; prioritize discovery and dispatch to existing dedicated Reviewer, Builder, or Scout peer sessions rather than spawning nested subagents; then continue to repository scale assessment or anchor capture, resolve active Tier 2 VCS capability, and determine if Scout reconnaissance is required, or proceed to direct survey.
Perform read-only topological reconnaissance and return a structured scout-survey message artifact to Planner.

Validate survey evidence or survey repository ground truth; inquire and confirm out-of-tree shadow scaffolding vault binding; upon explicit operator authorization, invoke initialization scaffolding (with vault scaffolding when confirmed) when living memory is absent (requiring explicit force authorization if replacing existing files) to scaffold baseline living memory and record vault binding in comprehensive AGENTS.md.
Review the current AGENTS.md artifact and report missing, ambiguous, or incorrect context.
Incorporate Reviewer feedback into the AGENTS.md artifact.
Review the updated AGENTS.md artifact and report missing, ambiguous, or incorrect context.
Incorporate Builder feedback into the AGENTS.md artifact.
Evaluate whether the current inquiry pass reached consensus.
Finalize and persist the AGENTS.md artifact at repository root.

name: plan
description: Author, review, and lock task-specific build and review plans through the Plan-Review Gate with Counterfactual Decomposition Challenge.

steps.action: Assess feature scope and complexity to branch between Hierarchical Blueprint and Single Plan; author task build-plan (or blueprint-plan) and review-plan in the resolved plan vault (~/.agentplaybook/<project>/plan/) with mandatory E2E Verification section and review-plan with mandatory E2E Coverage section, with verification paths for every material invariant and optional Track B definitions.
Submit draft plan artifacts to Reviewer for gate review.
Inspect plan artifacts for scope coherence, execute Counterfactual Decomposition Challenge (SPLIT_ATTEMPT and SPLIT_REJECTED_BECAUSE), and verify independent verification paths.
Revise plan artifacts based on Reviewer feedback, structural decomposition rationale, and Track B requirements.
Finalize approved plan artifacts in the plan vault and route to build flow (for single plan) or blueprint flow (for hierarchical blueprint).

name: blueprint
description: Execute hierarchical multi-stage feature development through blueprint gating, JIT sub-plan pairs, Planner-mediated remediation, and feature composition verification.

steps.action: Author the blueprint-plan artifact (<slug>.blueprint.md) in the resolved plan vault (~/.agentplaybook/<project>/plan/) defining high-level goals, shared interface contracts, invariant boundaries, feature-level E2E scope and composition obligations, and ordered sub-plan sequence.
Execute Blueprint Gate on <slug>.blueprint.md, validating architectural coherence, interface stability, and sub-plan boundary definitions.

Author JIT sub-plan pair in the plan vault: sub-build-plan (sub/<slug>.build.md) with mandatory E2E Verification section and sub-review-plan (sub/<slug>.review.md) with mandatory E2E Coverage section for the current sub-plan unit.
Execute Sub-Plan Gate on current sub-plan pair, evaluating verification coverage, boundaries, and Track B definitions.
Implement approved sub-build-plan strictly within declared file boundaries, execute local tests, and report verified diff and logs to Planner.

When Track B is selected, assert the pinned baseline identity tuple (repository_identity, baseline_identity) before evaluating differential measurements and emit BASELINE_STALE on drift; independently inspect code diff against sub-review-plan and report structured findings to Planner.
Mediate and sanitize review findings into actionable remediation instructions for Builder, strictly withholding review-plan artifacts.
Synthesize sanitized sub-review-resolution artifact (sub/<slug>.resolution.md) in the plan vault recording resolved findings, waivers, deviations, and verified evidence.
Verify sub-review-resolution artifact against sub-review-plan and determine sub-plan completion status.
Synthesize master composition review-resolution artifact (<slug>.resolution.md) in the plan vault summarizing global outcomes and cross-plan evidence.

Execute Feature Composition Gate across all completed sub-plans, shared contracts, regression suites, and required admitted E2E evidence (or reviewed not-required rationale), emitting FEATURE_REVIEW_PASS only when required E2E evidence is admitted.
Trigger Governed Milestone Acceptance and advance to the commit flow.

name: build
description: Execute blind handover, perform mandatory alignment, implement minimal changes, and verify locally.

steps.action: Dispatch the approved build-plan artifact from the plan vault to Builder via blind handover, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact.
Initiate implementation alignment with Planner regarding intent, scope, and edge cases before editing code.
Answer alignment inquiries and confirm scope boundaries and self-testing expectations.
Implement minimal required changes strictly within allowed files and verify with local automated tests.
Hand off the verified working copy diff and test execution logs to Planner without committing.
Inspect working copy diff against in-scope boundaries, verify local test execution, and hand off to Reviewer without committing.

name: review
description: Independently inspect code diff, evaluate severity and evidence modes (Track A/B or static), execute reproduction and fix loop, and synthesize review resolution.

steps.action: Forward verified diff from build flow to Reviewer for code review, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact in the plan vault.

When Track B is selected, assert the pinned baseline identity tuple (repository_identity, baseline_identity) before evaluating differential measurements and emit BASELINE_STALE on drift; inspect code diff against the review-plan artifact for scope compliance, correctness, test adequacy, Track B differentials, and classify findings into formal severities (Blocker, Major, Minor, Other) with evidence mode (unresolved Blocker blocks REVIEW_PASS; resolved or arbitrated Blocker and resolved or waived Major may pass; Minor and Other do not block).
Mediate and sanitize review-findings to Builder with severity and evidence mode, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact.

Establish a Track A failing reproduction test for behavioral findings (application code Out-of-Scope during this phase) or compile static/specification evidence for non-behavioral findings, then hand off to Planner for baseline verification before proceeding to fix.

Fix application code until all tests pass (or verified static evidence is produced); frozen test dependency surface must not be modified. Builder may begin Green work only after Planner has recorded the baseline reference and frozen dependency surface under Track A verification; Builder must not report FIX_VERIFIED until Planner has audited the frozen paths. Report resolved diff and test logs to Planner for frozen-path audit and VCS governance.

Planner classifies approved plan: if E2E is required (E2E_REQUIRED), freeze candidate revision and route to e2e flow; if E2E is not required (E2E_NOT_REQUIRED with documented rationale) or admitted E2E evidence is verified, synthesize sanitized review-resolution artifact in the plan vault, confirm REVIEW_PASS, and advance to the commit flow.
Arbitrate escalation with Reviewer (arbitrate Blocker, record waiver with rationale for Major, clarify/waive false positive, or evaluate scope change/plan update for unexpected error).
End the current review cycle and return to the plan flow to revise the task plans.

name: commit
description: Stabilize candidate identity, enforce Finalization Equivalence, update living operational memory, perform security scans, and seal revisions under VCS governance upon human authorization.

steps.action: Confirm independent review approval (REVIEW_PASS or FEATURE_REVIEW_PASS) and establish candidate baseline.
Await explicit user commit request to initiate persistence.
Query operational caveats from Builder and Reviewer (Reviewer must only report public, independently observable operational facts or 'no publishable caveats').
Update AGENTS.md with synthesized, sanitized caveats and fresh Observed-At provenance metadata.
Conduct narrow visibility and blind-barrier check on AGENTS.md to ensure no review secrets leaked.

Stabilize candidate snapshot identity, verify Finalization Equivalence (tree(Final) == tree(Verified)), and execute fail-closed secret scan via active security gate mechanism (non-zero exit code halts pipeline).
Present finalized candidate diff and Conventional Commit message, awaiting explicit human milestone acceptance authorization.
Verify unchanged candidate identity and seal milestone revision locally as ACCEPTED under Planner VCS governance via active VCS mechanism capability.
Publish sealed revision to remote repository under explicit publication authorization via active VCS mechanism capability.

name: session-handoff
description: Formally capture anchor state, conduct multi-round readiness audit, enforce scoping boundaries, and execute validated session takeover.

steps.action: First inspect active same-workspace peer sessions through the active harness transport; prioritize discovery and dispatch to existing dedicated Reviewer, Builder, or Scout peer sessions rather than spawning nested subagents; then continue to repository scale assessment or anchor capture: capture all State & Topology Anchor fields and handoff evidence.
Revalidate anchor against live repository ground truth through the active VCS mechanism and scoped inspection.

Complete Readiness Audit Round 1 across all four mandatory dimensions: Plan Understanding, Progress & State Understanding, Architectural & Governance Decisions, and Permissions & Path-Scoping Invariants.

Complete Readiness Audit Round 2 across all four mandatory dimensions (Plan Understanding, Progress & State Understanding, Architectural & Governance Decisions, and Permissions & Path-Scoping Invariants); challenge unresolved assumptions.

Complete Readiness Audit Round 3 across all four mandatory dimensions (Plan Understanding, Progress & State Understanding, Architectural & Governance Decisions, and Permissions & Path-Scoping Invariants); record questions and evidence.
Enforce exact authorized tool roots, peer-session discovery/dispatch policy, blind barrier, and takeover permissions.
Evaluate independent PLAN_REVIEW_PASS, declared boundaries, falsifiable contracts, VCS-neutral wording, authorization separation, and release cadence.
Emit compact validated takeover state with anchor, audit evidence, risks, and next pickup.

name: cartography
description: Orchestrate structured visual diagram generation with Taste Gate evaluation, conditional advisory pushback, and zero context pollution.

steps.action: Formulate self-contained diagram-brief specifying WHAT to draw (all entities, relationships, labels, groupings) without requiring codebase exploration.
Dispatch diagram-brief message artifact to Cartographer.
Evaluate visual type, complexity budget (≤12 nodes), and brief semantic completeness under Taste Gate criteria.
Dispatch structured diagram-clarification-request message to Planner and await resolution; Planner's amended diagram-brief provides the explicit source of CLARIFICATION_RESOLVED.
Calculate layout geometry, determine HOW to render (4px grid, orthogonal elbow routing), generate self-contained HTML/SVG, and delegate visual validation to the active diagramming capability.
Persist diagram to docs/diagrams/<safe-name>.html (or record advisory proposal) and emit lightweight diagram-completion message to commissioner.

name: navigator-cartography
description: Orchestrate structured visual diagram generation commissioned by Navigator with Taste Gate evaluation, conditional advisory pushback, and zero context pollution.

steps.action: Formulate self-contained diagram-brief specifying WHAT to draw (all entities, relationships, labels, groupings) without requiring codebase exploration.
Dispatch diagram-brief message artifact to Cartographer.
Evaluate visual type, complexity budget (≤12 nodes), and brief semantic completeness under Taste Gate criteria.
Dispatch structured diagram-clarification-request message to Navigator and await resolution; Navigator's amended diagram-brief provides the explicit source of CLARIFICATION_RESOLVED.
Calculate layout geometry, determine HOW to render (4px grid, orthogonal elbow routing), generate self-contained HTML/SVG, and delegate visual validation to the active diagramming capability.
Persist diagram to docs/diagrams/<safe-name>.html (or record advisory proposal) and emit lightweight diagram-completion message to commissioner (Navigator).

name: e2e
description: Execute end-to-end verification in an isolated out-of-tree sandbox, quarantining test logs and delivering compact evidence to Planner.

steps.action: Formulate structured e2e-brief artifact specifying immutable candidate revision SHA, fresh unique run_id, mode, package path, Secrets Policy inventory classifying each credential entity as throwaway-capable versus external-real-only, and any per-name real-credential authorization, requiring IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW_PASS before initial dispatch or after any remediation. All-throwaway runs proceed silently; runs with real-only entities require per-name explicit human authorization recorded in the brief, and wholesale secret store access is prohibited.
Dispatch e2e-brief message artifact, including Secrets Policy reference and credential authorization record, to Verifier.

Evaluate the execution package Secrets Policy before provisioning or container start; a policy-less specification is preflight-blocked with CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED and no provisioning or container start occurs. Self-check the sandbox credential directory against the specification allowlist by name, provision declared credentials with throwaway-by-default generation, then render infrastructure and start containers strictly after credential provisioning. Unsatisfied policy fails closed as ENV_BLOCKED with no step-skipping. Historical policy-less packages remain untouched on disk.

Execute test scenarios with provisioned credentials confined to the sandbox credential directory, redirecting and quarantining verbose stdout/stderr and trace logs to persistent E2E vault sandbox disk storage.

Remove generated credential directories including injected real-value residue and tear down containers before reporting, keeping credential file names only in evidence, and emit lightweight e2e-report message artifact carrying secrets_attestation with mode to Planner.

Evaluate Verifier report against admission criteria (candidate SHA match, scenario coverage, allowed skips, artifact digest provenance, secrets attestation presence with mode matching brief authorization, and token budget <150 tokens). Missing or mismatched attestation, or evidence containing credential material, fails closed as E2E_INVALID_EVIDENCE.
Arbitrate product or build failure, sanitize defect trace into actionable remediation instructions for Builder (strictly withholding review-plan artifacts), and coordinate code or package fixes.
Independently inspect remediation diffs and updated test packages; emit IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW_PASS only when all fixes and regression tests are verified.
Resolve environment blockers, including credential provisioning blocks, or answer clarification requests, formulating amended execution parameters or routing package defects to remediation.

Investigate timeout, cancellation, or invalid evidence, including secrets attestation failures, arbitrating retry authorization on unchanged candidate, escalating package/code defects to remediation, or halting execution.
Incorporate verified and admitted E2E evidence into Feature Composition Gate or Review Resolution and advance to final review.

Terminate E2E verification without acceptance upon fatal error, unresolvable defect, or cancellation; record non-acceptance disposition and halt pipeline without dispatching further runs or admitting candidate to commit flow.
